countdown.title: Watch the day come closer
countdown.text: Add the day that matters, put it on your Home Screen and watch it come closer. Count down to a date or count up from one, with repeats every year, month, week or few days.

countdown.title: Every widget, free
countdown.text: One countdown, the next few in a list, a spotlight, or a tile for each — in every size, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen. Unlimited events, reminders and iCloud sync are free too.

countdown.title: Start from a template
countdown.text: Thirty-six ready-made events, from a birthday to a first day at work, each already set up with the right repeat and the right reminders.

countdown.title: The back of every event
countdown.text: Tap an event and it turns over to a page of its own. Write a few lines, add photos, record a voice — the story of the day, kept with the day and shared as one picture.

countdown.title: Make it look like yours
countdown.text: Two hundred drawn icons, the whole emoji keyboard and 140 full-screen backdrops — 22 of them photographs, 88 of them in Pro.

countdown.title: Your days, kept
countdown.text: Every day the app takes a snapshot of all your events on this device, and always before anything risky: thirty days of history, one tap to restore, and nothing leaves your phone.

countdown.title: Days that passed stay with you
countdown.text: Past days are never deleted. They collect into a timeline you can look back through, with the longest wait of each year written next to it.

invoiceqr.title: Invoices in minutes
invoiceqr.text: Pick one of 100+ templates, add your client and items, and share a polished PDF. Start with an estimate or quote and turn it into an invoice with one tap.

invoiceqr.title: Scan a paper invoice
invoiceqr.text: Photograph a paper invoice, or pick a photo, and it becomes an editable draft. The page is read on your device; the optional AI review sends it to Google only when you ask.

invoiceqr.title: Get paid with a scan
invoiceqr.text: Every invoice can carry a payment QR code your clients scan to pay. See paid, unpaid, partial and overdue at a glance, and share a paid invoice as a receipt.

invoiceqr.title: Know what is still owed
invoiceqr.text: Sales reports show income by month, your top clients and what is still outstanding.

invoiceqr.title: Your brand on everything
invoiceqr.text: Set your logo, brand color and fonts once, and invoices, templates and QR designs pick them up automatically.

invoiceqr.title: A QR code studio too
invoiceqr.text: Twelve QR types, from links and Wi-Fi to payment and Pix, and sixteen ready-made designs. Contrast and quiet zone are checked, so the code always scans.

invoiceqr.title: On your Home Screen
invoiceqr.text: Three widgets: what you're owed, quick create shortcuts, and a payment QR drawn large enough to hold up and scan.

beforego.title: Drop it in, get a trip plan
beforego.text: Screenshot a travel post, paste a link or just type your plans, and BeforeGo files it into a day-by-day plan: the places worth seeing, the to-dos before you go, and each day the post lays out.

beforego.title: Bookings on the plan
beforego.text: Scan a ticket or booking confirmation and it lands on the plan. Bookings keep a price and currency, and include shows and events, transfers and rental cars.

beforego.title: A packing list that writes itself
beforego.text: Plugs, currency, entry rules and transit apps for where you are going, generated from your destination and dates, with reminders 7 days, 3 days, 24 hours and 3 hours before you leave.

beforego.title: Places to go, things to tick off
beforego.text: The places you save become a trip checklist — spots, food and experiences to check off as you go — and a day of stops sorts itself into the shortest walking route.

beforego.title: Split the trip's costs
beforego.text: Add expenses in the trip's currencies, choose who paid and split each bill across the people traveling. Photograph a receipt to fill an expense, and Settle up shows the shortest way to clear the balances.

beforego.title: After the trip
beforego.text: Photos, notes and voice memos kept by trip, a printable memories album, and forgotten items that carry over so the next packing list starts smarter.

beforego.title: On your Home Screen
beforego.text: Countdown and checklist widgets keep the trip in view without opening the app.
